contract.question: Does s_z>=c (tick562 PROVED ejection-steepness) + Type-I + R1 (tick570) discharge the Constantin-Fefferman vorticity-direction-Lipschitz Clay-equivalent criterion on the non-tangential inherited bad cascade? Claim: NO — s_z is ejection MAGNITUDE; CF depletion needs the SIGN of the omega-strain alignment (omega vs compressing/stretching strain eigenvector) + direction-Lipschitz, which is undetermined by Type-I/CKN/R1/s_z. So the irreducible open core sharpens to: the vorticity-strain alignment sign / CF direction-coherence on the s_z>=c cascade — the shared falsifiable discriminator for BOTH the regularity channel and the inversion/blowup-construction channel.
